_comment: Two records from one allocation site: the first is provided as an unrelated Config service, the second (holding only a string) is a Schedule's input whose callback calls the method of a captured service that the string names. Only the first is a service, so the second may enter the Schedule: the named method stays and the bundle runs. Guards that a record sharing an allocation site with a provided value still names a method. The unread one is not checked: Schedule.fromStep's step is a callback handed to type-modelled code and runs with unknown arguments, so the computed read through its input is an unknown key and keeps every method (accepted imprecision; the pass no longer steps a Schedule). (Before the deletion it guarded that the Schedule input filter did not drop an object because its allocation site may also be provided; that filter is gone.)
